title: Seedha Saadha Raita (Yogurt with Mint and Cucumber)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Simple spiced yogurt with herbs, onion, and cucumber.

items: ½ cup cilantro, finely chopped, or ⅓ cup mint, finely chopped, or both
½ cup red onion, chopped (any onion ok)
1 cup peeled cucumber, in ⅓ in (1 cm) dice

edits: Ground roasted cumin isn't defined in the book; toast cumin seeds as for Garam Masala, then grind
